title: Module Has Graph Primitives
description: Ensure every Class, Interface, Scalar, and persisted FieldKind enum value is contained via `Module HAS` under the `graphql` module tree; remove duplicate `HAS` from schema-level `general`/`domain` modules; document sibling-unique module names in SDL.
summary: Relinked all interfaces from YAML `general` (entity family → `graphql`→`Entity`) and `domain`/`vcs` (workspace, diff, modification, operation, backbone, provider, command → the unique `General`→child modules under `graphql`). Moved scalars to `graphql`→`Scalar`. Added `Module` `FieldKind` under `graphql` with `Enum` nodes EMBEDDED, REFERENCE, COMPUTED, CACHED. Updated `semio/dev/schema/neo4j/schema.graphql` (`Enum` type, `Module.enums`) and `.repo/🛂/semio.cypher` (enum index, fulltext label set, idempotent `📦ModuleHasPrimitives` region). Live graph updated via Neo4j MCP write.
